am.mysuru-angala.about: An explicitly interpretive Mysuru courtyard setting using synthetic inlay and project-original placeholder artwork.
am.mysuru-angala.claim.inlay: Mysuru is associated with a documented regional tradition of wood inlay handicraft.
am.mysuru-angala.claim.interpretive: The courtyard and material contrast are an artistic setting, not a claim that this board is authentic Mysore rosewood inlay.
am.mysuru-angala.disclosure.interpretive: Mysūru Aṅgaḷa is a digital homage. It uses no protected emblem, copied artisan motif, ivory, or endangered material.
am.mysuru-angala.intent: Count every seed and plan the next harvest.
am.mysuru-angala.teaching.capture-1: Four seeds gather into the store; count the next sowing chain before lifting a pit.
am.mysuru-angala.teaching.lose-1: The other store holds the larger harvest; count one relay further next time.
am.mysuru-angala.teaching.win-1: The fuller store carries the harvest after patient counting.
am.mysuru-angala.title: Mysūru Aṅgaḷa — Mysuru Courtyard
